headline: Front-Line Turnover Persists as Sectors Trade Bases
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger shows renewed movement on several contested fronts, though the war remains without a victor. FishermansRowHex has become the sharpest immediate turnover board, recording four events in the latest two hours and 25 in 24 hours, with two strategic bases presently neutral and seven Colonial-held. WeatheredExpanseHex also reports three fresh events, 33 in the day, and a close four-Warden-to-five-Colonial division; casualty rates have accelerated in the latest one-hour comparison. StlicanShelf has added two recent events to a 30-event day and remains split seven Warden to two Colonial, while Stonecradle’s 16 daily events include seven in six hours, despite a quiet latest two-hour window. Godcrofts has gone quiet in the last two hours after leading the prior report, but still carries 56 events for the day and all nine bases Colonial-held. DeadLands, newly prominent in the figures, shows six daily events, intense and accelerating enlistment and casualty rates, and all eleven bases currently Colonial. Elsewhere, heavy fighting continues in CallahansPassage and MooringCounty without recorded fresh base events.
